data.name: Bramble Armor
data.description: You can cause a host of wooden thorns to burst from your skin as a free action. While Bramble Armor is in effect, any foe striking you with an unarmed strike or a melee weapon without reach takes 1d6+%1 points of piercing damage. You can use this ability for %2 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|DomainPlantLVL/2|BrambleArmorRounds
